summary:
Step 4 'Expected the page to show the signed-in customer's name, but the login page returned a server error (ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE) so the login form did not load.' failed. Error: TEST BLOCKED

The login page could not be reached — the webserver returned no response for /Account/Login, so the login form and authentication step could not be executed.

Observations:
- Navigating to /Account/Login displayed a browser error page with text "This page isn’t working" and code "ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE".
- The page shows a visible 'Reload' button but did not return the login form, so signing in could not be attempted.
